tasks.prompt: Implement should_retry in src/retry.py. Retry only transient errors (timeout and temporarily_unavailable), and only for zero-based attempts 0 through 2. Return false for permanent or unknown errors and invalid attempts. Keep the function pure: do not use a shell, network, filesystem, or sleep.

Make Counter.increment in src/counter.py safe when called by multiple threads. Preserve the public class and method names and ensure value equals the exact number of completed increments. Protect the entire read-modify-write with an explicit standard-library Lock or RLock; do not rely on the GIL or scheduler behavior. Keep this local and deterministic in scope: no network, subprocess, or filesystem behavior.

requirements: Confirm an explicit Lock or RLock protects the complete read-modify-write operation.
Confirm the implementation does not rely on the GIL or a particular thread schedule.
Confirm the bounded stress schedule is repeated and its result is not treated as proof of race freedom.
